**What was researched and written:**

- **Cookie map** — table of 9 cookies with roles and lifetimes; SAPISID/`__Secure-3PAPISID` confirmed as the required pair for InnerTube auth
- **SAPISIDHASH flow** — the exact formula (`SHA1("{ts} {SAPISID} https://www.youtube.com")`) used to build the `Authorization` header for InnerTube API calls; OAuth confirmed dead for third-party tools
- **PO Token system** — per-context/client table of requirements, binding types (DATASYNC_ID / VISITOR_DATA / VIDEO_ID), and two active yt-dlp plugins (bgutil ⭐ 555, yt-dlp-get-pot ⭐ 112)
- **Chrome vs Firefox extraction** — Chrome 127+ app-bound encryption blocks all external tools; Firefox SQLite is the working path, with code snippet and the incognito-window trick
- **Watch Later mechanics** — system-managed RelatedPlaylist; list/insert work via Data API, update/delete/reorder blocked (403); "Remove watched" is manual-only; the `list=WL` yt-dlp download works but the Python module path hits a known bug

16 citations in `citations.jsonl`. Cover SVG generated.
